title: Covenants
description: Financial covenants on the selected client's facilities at the last quarterly test, tightest headroom first.

custom.cypher:
MATCH (h:Holding)-[:HAS_COVENANT]->(c:Covenant)-[:FOR_CLIENT]->(:Client {clientId: $clientId})
WITH c, h, CASE c.unit WHEN 'USD' THEN '$' + toString(round(c.actual / 1000000.0, 1)) + 'M'
                       WHEN '%' THEN toString(round(c.actual, 1)) + '%'
                       ELSE toString(round(c.actual, 2)) + 'x' END AS actual,
           CASE c.unit WHEN 'USD' THEN '$' + toString(round(c.threshold / 1000000.0, 1)) + 'M'
                       WHEN '%' THEN toString(round(c.threshold, 1)) + '%'
                       ELSE toString(round(c.threshold, 2)) + 'x' END AS threshold
RETURN c.name AS name, h.productName AS facility, actual, c.operator + ' ' + threshold AS limit, c.headroomPct AS headroomPct, c.status AS status
ORDER BY headroomPct
